1512 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception because 1512 is not divisible by 100).  
January has 31 days.  
89 days before Jan 19, 1512:  
First, go back 19 days to Jan 1, 1512 → 19 days subtracted, 70 left.  
Then back 31 days (Dec 1511) → 51 left.  
Then back 30 days (Nov) → 21 left.  
Then back 31 days (Oct) → need 21 days before Oct 1 → Oct 1 back 21 days = Sep 10, 1511.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1511-09-10
